title: In This World Unsent Letters Arrive 20 Years Later
description: A mailman has delivered 9,000 letters people never sent, and not one was ever for him. Who would your unsent letter be to? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Daisuke: 62-year-old Japanese man, short gray hair neatly combed, thin gray mustache, plain navy-blue postal worker uniform jacket with no logo and no text, white shirt, navy trousers, black shoes, worn brown leather mail bag over one shoulder, no hat, no glasses
characters.Kenta: 30-year-old Japanese man, short black hair, quiet face, the same plain navy-blue postal worker uniform jacket with no logo and no text, white shirt, navy trousers, black shoes, brown leather mail bag, no hat, no glasses
characters.Young Kenta: 10-year-old Japanese boy, short black bowl-cut hair, striped blue and white T-shirt, tan shorts, white socks, no hat
characters.Old Woman: 70-year-old Japanese woman, gray hair in a low bun, lavender cardigan over a cream blouse, dark gray skirt, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, every letter you write but never send gets delivered anyway, twenty years later. Daisuke has carried nine thousand of them. Not one was ever for him.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Daisuke walks alone down a quiet 1990s Japanese residential lane of old wooden houses in soft morning light, brown mail bag on his shoulder. [4-7s] Close-up of Daisuke's weathered hand lifting a faded yellowed blank envelope out of his mail bag on the same lane. [7-10s] Medium shot of Daisuke standing at the low wooden gate of a small house, looking at the envelope with a tired, gentle face.

scenes.say: So he's seen everything. An apology to a sister. A love letter to a woman now sixty. People cry on doorsteps. But on Daisuke's own doormat, in forty years, nothing.
scenes.video: [0-4s] At the sliding wooden front door of a small house, Old Woman takes a faded blank envelope from Daisuke and presses it to her chest, eyes filling with tears. [4-7s] Close-up of Old Woman on her doorstep, smiling and crying at once while Daisuke bows politely. [7-10s] Inside the narrow entryway of Daisuke's own small apartment at dusk, Daisuke takes off his shoes and glances down at an empty doormat.

scenes.say: His son Kenta joined the post office two years ago. They work in the same building and barely speak. Kenta was always the quiet one, even at ten.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a dim wooden-floored post office sorting room, Daisuke and Kenta sort envelopes at separate tables, backs to each other. [4-7s] Close-up of Kenta at his sorting table, glancing over his shoulder at his father, then looking away. [7-10s] Flashback in a small 1990s child's bedroom: Young Kenta slides a plain blank envelope into the back of his desk drawer and shuts it quickly.

scenes.say: Today is Daisuke's last day after forty years. Nobody throws a party. Then Kenta walks over from his sorting table and holds out one faded envelope. It's for Daisuke.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the empty post office sorting room in late afternoon light, Daisuke slowly folds his mail bag on his table. [4-7s] Medium shot: Kenta walks across the sorting room toward his father holding one faded yellowed blank envelope. [7-10s] Close-up inside the sorting room: Kenta's hand holding out the envelope, Daisuke's surprised face behind it.

scenes.say: Twenty years old. Written by a ten year old too shy to hand it over. It says, 'Dad, when I grow up, I want to carry letters like you.'
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up in the sorting room of Daisuke's trembling hands opening the faded envelope. [4-7s] Close-up of Daisuke's eyes going wet as he reads a sheet of paper seen only from behind, no writing visible. [7-10s] Medium shot in the sorting room: Kenta stands beside the table looking at the floor, ears turning red.

scenes.say: Daisuke looks up. Kenta is wearing the same uniform. Neither of them says a word. After nine thousand letters, Daisuke finally got one. His son delivered it himself.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up in the sorting room: Daisuke lowers the paper and looks up at Kenta. [4-7s] Medium shot of father and son standing face to face in matching navy uniforms by the sorting room window, Daisuke putting a hand on Kenta's shoulder. [7-10s] On the quiet residential lane at sunset, Daisuke and Kenta walk home side by side, each with a mail bag on his shoulder.
